SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);

SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');


#DROP TABLE IF EXISTS s_ipd_thai;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_ipd_thai(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
  target10 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result10 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  target11 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result11 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  target12 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result12 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  target01 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result01 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  target02 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result02 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  target03 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result03 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  target04 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result04 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  target05 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result05 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  target06 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result06 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  target07 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result07 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  target08 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result08 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  target09 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result09 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)

) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_ipd_thai WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_ipd_thai 
(
	SELECT 
		 @id,s.hospcode,concat(h.provcode,h.distcode,h.subdistcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode	
		,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year

		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(DATE_FORMAT(s.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year-1,'1001') AND CONCAT(@b_year-1,'1031')
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.an),NULL))
		,SUM(if(DATE_FORMAT(s.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year-1,'1001') AND CONCAT(@b_year-1,'1031'),s.day,0))
		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(DATE_FORMAT(s.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year-1,'1101') AND CONCAT(@b_year-1,'1131')
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.an),NULL))
		,SUM(if(DATE_FORMAT(s.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year-1,'1101') AND CONCAT(@b_year-1,'1131'),s.day,0))

		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(DATE_FORMAT(s.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year-1,'1201') AND CONCAT(@b_year-1,'1231')
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.an),NULL))
		,SUM(if(DATE_FORMAT(s.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year-1,'1201') AND CONCAT(@b_year-1,'1231'),s.day,0))
		
		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(DATE_FORMAT(s.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0101') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0131')
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.an),NULL))
		,SUM(if(DATE_FORMAT(s.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0101') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0131'),s.day,0))


		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(DATE_FORMAT(s.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0201') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0231')
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.an),NULL))
		,SUM(if(DATE_FORMAT(s.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0201') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0231'),s.day,0))

		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(DATE_FORMAT(s.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0301') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0331')
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.an),NULL))
		,SUM(if(DATE_FORMAT(s.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0301') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0331'),s.day,0))

		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(DATE_FORMAT(s.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0401') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0431')
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.an),NULL))
		,SUM(if(DATE_FORMAT(s.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0401') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0431'),s.day,0))

		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(DATE_FORMAT(s.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0501') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0531')
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.an),NULL))
		,SUM(if(DATE_FORMAT(s.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0501') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0531'),s.day,0))

		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(DATE_FORMAT(s.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0601') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0631')
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.an),NULL))
		,SUM(if(DATE_FORMAT(s.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0601') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0631'),s.day,0))

		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(DATE_FORMAT(s.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0701') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0731')
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.an),NULL))
		,SUM(if(DATE_FORMAT(s.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0701') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0731'),s.day,0))

		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(DATE_FORMAT(s.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0801') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0831')
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.an),NULL))
		,SUM(if(DATE_FORMAT(s.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0801') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0831'),s.day,0))

		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(DATE_FORMAT(s.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0901') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0931')
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.an),NULL))
		,SUM(if(DATE_FORMAT(s.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0901') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0931'),s.day,0))

	FROM
		tmp_admission s,chospital h
	WHERE
		s.hospcode=h.hoscode
		AND s.nation=99 
		AND DATE_FORMAT(s.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d
		AND h.provcode = @prov_c
	GROUP BY
	s.hospcode,areacode
);
